emeron vendored dependencies
============================

Exact upstream revisions. Keep this in sync with the *_TAG values in
cmake/Dependencies.cmake -- the build prints which origin it used, and these
are what `-DEMERON_VENDORED=OFF` would download instead.

dear imgui
  repository  https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git
  tag         v1.92.9b-docking
  commit      b48d1afbe8ee8b238e2961dc363a949dd7304e23
  license     MIT (vendor/imgui/LICENSE.txt)
  note        The docking branch, not master: emeron needs
              ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable and ViewportsEnable.
  pruned      examples/, docs/, misc/ except misc/cpp, every backend except
              glfw + opengl3. Kept imgui_demo.cpp -- Help -> Dear ImGui demo
              uses it and it is the reference for widget usage.
  patched     imgui_tables.cpp, 3 spots marked "EMERON PATCH": a table
              column's stretch weight could become NaN (0/0 when the table
              was laid out at zero width), was saved to imgui.ini as
              "Weight=nan", and collapsed the column on every launch -- the
              Log panel's Message column wrapped one character per line.
              The patch guards both divisions and ignores a saved weight
              that is not a positive finite number.
              Test: tests/test_table_settings.cpp. Re-apply on every update.

implot
  repository  https://github.com/epezent/implot.git
  tag         v1.0
  commit      524f9fcd48d76c13fdf94c5ffbba8787a1ff7e39
  license     MIT (vendor/implot/LICENSE)
  note        v1.0 replaced the SetNextLineStyle/ImPlotStyle per-item fields
              with ImPlotSpec. Code in src/ui/panels uses the v1.0 API; do not
              downgrade without updating it.
  pruned      example/, README.md, TODO.md

glfw
  repository  https://github.com/glfw/glfw.git
  tag         3.4
  commit      7b6aead9fb88b3623e3b3725ebb42670cbe4c579
  license     Zlib/libpng (vendor/glfw/LICENSE.md)
  note        Built through its own CMakeLists via add_subdirectory.
  pruned      docs/, examples/, tests/, and every deps/ entry except:
                deps/wayland  -- protocol XML the Linux Wayland backend
                                 generates headers from (src/CMakeLists.txt:80)
                deps/mingw    -- headers the MinGW Windows build needs
                                 (src/CMakeLists.txt:277)
              Everything else under deps/ (glad, nuklear, getopt, tinycthread,
              linmath, stb_image_write) is used only by examples and tests,
              which GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES/TESTS=OFF never configures.

nativefiledialog-extended
  repository  https://github.com/btzy/nativefiledialog-extended.git
  tag         v1.4.1
  commit      65b2f070a0fcfee0d453a64e770a217ab0b6ff4f
  license     Zlib (vendor/nfd/LICENSE)
  note        The OS Save / Choose Folder dialogs. Optional: on Linux it needs
              gtk+-3.0 or dbus-1, and cmake/Dependencies.cmake builds without it
              (in-app fallback prompt) when neither is installed.
  pruned      test/, screens/, 3ps/, README.md. All five headers in
              src/include are kept even though emeron only includes nfd.h and
              nfd_glfw3.h -- upstream's src/CMakeLists.txt lists the SDL
              helpers as sources and fails to configure without them.

miniz
  repository  https://github.com/richgel999/miniz.git
  tag         3.1.2
  file        release asset miniz-3.1.2.zip (amalgamated miniz.c + miniz.h)
              sha256 f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a
  license     MIT (vendor/miniz/LICENSE)
  note        Inflate for the screen mirror, which compresses frames with
              gzip on the device (10.6 MB raw -> 1.7 MB). Always vendored, see
              cmake/Dependencies.cmake. Built with MINIZ_NO_ARCHIVE_APIS,
              _NO_STDIO, _NO_TIME and _NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES.
  pruned      examples/, ChangeLog.md, readme.md.

scrcpy server
  repository  https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy.git
  tag         v3.3.4
  file        release asset scrcpy-server-v3.3.4, unmodified
              sha256 8588238c9a5a00aa542906b6ec7e6d5541d9ffb9b5d0f6e1bc0e365e2303079e
              (matches the digest GitHub publishes for the asset)
  license     Apache-2.0 (vendor/scrcpy/LICENSE)
  note        The Screen panel's Fast engine pushes it to the device, runs it
              for the session, and talks to it over an adb tunnel. It deletes
              itself on start. Embedded into the binary by CMakeLists.txt.
              The client/server protocol is internal to scrcpy and changes
              between releases, and the server refuses another version: on an
              update, bump EMERON_SCRCPY_VERSION and re-check every layout in
              src/collect/ScrcpyProtocol.cpp against app/src/control_msg.c and
              the server's Streamer/DesktopConnection at the new tag --
              tests/test_scrcpy_protocol.cpp copies scrcpy's own serializer
              test vectors, so update those too.
  pruned      everything but the server asset and LICENSE.

ImGuiNotify
  repository  https://github.com/TyomaVader/ImGuiNotify.git
  commit      d00e45f8d6b1e094bc9288d20eb3d2840f6a7d73
  file        unixExample/backends/ImGuiNotify.hpp (header-only)
              upstream sha256 e50cde11f092fae2a54ea529faac292cc556fcf36158c78479d6d3c21c46cd4c
              The win32Example copy differs in one line (wraps text at the
              toast's own width, which is circular with AlwaysAutoResize);
              the unix one wraps at a third of the window.
  license     MIT (vendor/ImGuiNotify/LICENSE)
  note        Toasts, through src/ui/Notifications.cpp (thread-safe queue,
              theme colours, configuration).
  patched     ImGuiNotify.hpp, spots marked "EMERON PATCH":
              * the configuration macros are #ifndef-guarded, so the app
                configures them instead of editing the header;
              * the dismiss button erased the toast and then kept using the
                pointer to it for the rest of the loop -- a use-after-free when
                it was the last toast. It is now removed after End();
              * an expired toast's removal no longer skips the next toast;
              * colours: the built-in ones are 0-255 values in an ImVec4,
                which ImGui clamps to 0-1 (blue showed cyan, warnings pure
                yellow, unreadable on a light theme). ImGuiToast::colorOverride
                lets emeron use its contrast-checked palette.
              Re-apply on every update: grep -n "EMERON PATCH".
  pruned      everything but ImGuiNotify.hpp and LICENSE.

Font Awesome Free (Solid)
  repository  https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome.git
  tag         6.7.2
  commit      af620534bfc3c2d4cbefcfeec29603bbe7809e64
  file        webfonts/fa-solid-900.ttf
              sha256 af19d135d3a935b3ebfbd80320716ffe1202052c5f68dc2c5f1abc57005ac605
  license     Font: SIL OFL 1.1. Icons: CC BY 4.0. (vendor/fontawesome/LICENSE.txt)
  note        Embedded into the binary at build time by cmake/EmbedFile.cmake,
              so this file stays byte-identical to upstream. Version 6, not 7:
              7.x ships only .woff2, which stb_truetype cannot read.
  pruned      everything but the Solid TTF and LICENSE.txt.

IconFontCppHeaders
  repository  https://github.com/juliettef/IconFontCppHeaders.git
  commit      210b5a399a64270674560d633638952d1e8d804d
  license     Zlib (vendor/IconFontCppHeaders/licence.txt)
  note        IconsFontAwesome6.h -- the ICON_FA_* names, generated from the
              Font Awesome 6.x metadata so it matches the font above.
              tests/test_fonts.cpp checks that every one of its 1402 icons has a
              glyph in the embedded font. Keep the two in step: a header from
              one release beside a font from another compiles and draws boxes.
  pruned      every file but IconsFontAwesome6.h and licence.txt.

Not used: https://github.com/xo1337/FontAwesome. It pairs a Font Awesome 5 Pro
header with a Font Awesome 4.7 font; only 462 of its 1853 icons (24%) render.
